Exclusive: Musk tells Isaacson "AI and robots" will need to fix deficit
market.summary: Elon Musk tells biographer Walter Isaacson in a new podcast interview that the fizzled DOGE experiment, which the SpaceX and Tesla CEO once headed, proved there's "no way we were gonna solve the deficit from within the government." "The only way we're going to solve the national debt is with AI and robots," Musk tells the author for a new podcast series, " The Builders with Walter Isaacson ," premiering Tuesday. "We're not gonna solve it by trying to save our way there." Why it matters: Musk's comments to Isaacson — author of the definitive 2023 biography, " Elon Musk " — admit that DOGE was a flop, but point to the chance that some future administration will take a new stab at the problem using ever-more-capable AI. Zoom in: Musk said the appetite to cut spending "is not there at the presidency, the House, the Senate or the judiciary. Basically, no one in authority in the government whatsoever — with maybe a few rare exceptions [like the] Rand Pauls of the world — actually wants to reduce spending." "Maybe if the president made that his primary goal, we could do that," Musk added. "If you try to solve the deficit and stop wasteful spending, you make a lot of enemies. President Trump likes to be liked. He doesn't like people calling him, being upset about ... some funding being stopped." Musk admits he "kinda got carried away, basically" and that he wound up being "gone for too long" from his companies. "What I should have done," he added, "was be more in the background ... and probably only had it last for a month or two" rather than the four months he was formally in the White House. "I should have gone back and focused on AI a little sooner than I did." When Isaacson asked Musk if his time in the West Wing had been too seductive, in a way, Musk replied: "It was, a little bit. I mean, it was kinda cool 'cause ... I'm just there in the Oval Office while all these, like, big momentous decisions are being made." Asked about the time he brandished a chainsaw onstage at the Conservative Political Action Conference (CPAC) a month into Trump's second term, Musk said: "That was a weird weekend." Pressed to elaborate, Musk said: "Let's let sleeping dogs lie or whatever." The big picture: Isaacson warned this week that Steve Jobs and the other great creators of the personal computer age would be cautious about autonomous AI agents not tightly connected to human control. Isaacson includes his warning in the new preface to an updated edition, published this week, of his sweeping 2014 history of the digital age, " The Innovators : How a Group of Hackers, Geniuses, and Geeks Created the Digital Revolution." Behind the scenes: Isaacson tells me he launched "The Builders" because he wanted to press the builders of this new AI age on these dangers and hear in their own voices what motivates them. "Musk is an amazing engineer who is pushing us forward with Starship, Starlink, Neuralink, and autonomous EVs," Isaacson said. "But as I describe in my biography, I think he is too prone to darkness and conspiracies when it comes to politics and people. His complexities come through in the interview, as I hope they do in the biography." What's next: Isaacson's podcast series, created by media company Kaleidoscope , includes conversations with Peter Thiel, Alex Karp, Fei-Fei Li, and Dario and Daniela Amodei. A series preview says the tech legends "open up about their ambitions, what frightens them, how they think about humanity, and what drives them to build so big and so fast. The conversations are intimate, charming, and sometimes chilling." Listen to a trailer for "The Builders."

The company faces margin pressures from $14 million in tariff costs and inflation, though strong demand persists in healthcare and life sciences markets. Management maintains fiscal 2027 EPS guidance at $11.12 with projected 7.3% revenue growth.

ABT.title: Haemonetics Gains 149.3% in a Year: What's Driving the Rally?
ABT.summary: Haemonetics shares surged 149.3% over the past year, significantly outperforming the industry and S&P 500. The company's Plasma and MedSurg segments showed solid growth in Q1 fiscal 2027, with Plasma revenues up 7.2% and MedSurg up 6%. HAE raised its fiscal 2027 revenue guidance to 5-8%, but faces headwinds from high debt levels ($1.17 billion long-term debt) and competitive pressures.

ABT.title: Is it Apt to Retain Medtronic Stock in Your Portfolio Now?
ABT.summary: Medtronic is expanding its presence in high-growth markets including cardiac ablation (up 88%), robotics, and structural heart, while advancing the MiniMed separation. The company is building its hypertension business through the Symplicity Spyral renal denervation franchise with improved reimbursement and clinical evidence. However, Medtronic faces headwinds from tariffs, inflation, currency fluctuations, and unfavorable product mix that could pressure margins.

SCHW.title: Schwab Q3 Earnings Beat on Higher NIR, Stock Slides on Revenue Miss
SCHW.summary: Charles Schwab reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $1.69, beating estimates of $1.66 with 29% year-over-year growth. However, revenues of $7.17B missed expectations of $7.19B, causing shares to decline 4.5% in pre-market trading. Positive drivers included record core net new assets of $190.4B (up 38%), higher net interest revenues (+14% to $3.48B), and increased trading revenues (+16% to $1.16B). Headwinds included rising expenses (+9% to $3.24B) and concerns about revenue sustainability amid uncertain interest rates.

TSM.title: Taiwan Semiconductor Posts Record Q3 Results: Time to Buy the Dip?
TSM.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) delivered record Q3 earnings of $4.60 per share, beating expectations by 3%, with revenue surging 41% year-over-year to $46.72 billion. The company issued strong Q4 guidance of $52.3-$54.3 billion in revenue, implying 58% year-over-year growth and exceeding Wall Street expectations. With a reasonable valuation of 25X forward earnings and 24 consecutive quarters of earnings beats, TSM is positioned as a leading beneficiary of the AI infrastructure boom.

TSM.title: TSMC's Record Q3 Earnings & Upbeat Outlook Put These ETFs in Focus
TSM.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) reported record third-quarter earnings exceeding expectations with revenues of $46.36 billion and net profit climbing 68.7% year-over-year. The company projects Q4 revenues of $52.3-$54.3 billion, significantly above estimates, driven by sustained AI chip demand. Advanced technologies now account for 79% of wafer revenue, with high-performance computing representing 68% of total revenue. TSMC plans increased capital expenditure through 2028 and expects mass production at its second Arizona facility by Q3 2027.

TSM.title: Bull of the Day: ASE Technology Holding Co (ASX)
TSM.summary: ASE Technology, the world's largest outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (OSAT) provider, has dropped to an attractive buy zone near $40 during recent market volatility. With a Zacks #1 Rank, the company is projected to achieve over 125% EPS growth by 2026 with topline growth reaching $26 billion. ASE benefits from the AI boom, advanced packaging demand, and foundry capacity constraints that are driving customers to outsource more backend semiconductor services.

BMY.title: Can Gilead's Deal With VIR Boost Its Oncology Pipeline and Growth?
BMY.summary: Gilead Sciences entered a collaboration with Vir Biotechnology to develop three novel T-cell engagers targeting solid tumors. Vir will receive $90 million upfront plus up to $1.74 billion in milestone payments. The deal reflects Gilead's strategy to diversify beyond HIV into oncology, though near-term profitability faces pressure from deal costs and competition from rivals like AstraZeneca and Bristol Myers in cancer therapies.

PFE.title: Obesity Clinical Trial and Competitive Landscape Surges as 200+ Companies Advance Next-Generation Therapies | DelveInsight
PFE.summary: Over 200 companies are advancing next-generation obesity therapies, with more than 30 drugs in late-stage development and 180+ in mid and early stages. Key players include Eli Lilly, Novo Nordisk, Viking Therapeutics, and Roche, developing innovative mechanisms like dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists and triple hormone receptor agonists. Recent approvals include Novo Nordisk's oral Wegovy formulation and Eli Lilly's orforglipron, while multiple Phase III trials show promising weight loss results.

QBTS.summary: A shareholder class action lawsuit has been filed against D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS), alleging that the company made false and misleading statements and overstated its business and financial prospects. Investors who purchased shares between February 26, 2026 and August 25, 2026 and experienced losses are encouraged to contact the law firm. The deadline to be appointed lead plaintiff is December 14, 2026.

QBTS.title: Rigetti Falls 21% in the Past Month: Hold or Fold the Stock Now?
QBTS.summary: Rigetti Computing (RGTI) stock declined 21% over the past month as investors worry about the company's path to profitability and commercialization timeline. While the company benefits from a strong $541.3M cash position, zero debt, and a $100M U.S. government award, widening operating losses ($28.1M in Q2 2026) and heavy dependence on government contracts and research-stage customers remain concerns. The stock trades at a premium 7.84 P/B ratio despite persistent losses.

KO.title: Coca-Cola (KO) Ascends While Market Falls: Some Facts to Note
KO.summary: Coca-Cola (KO) closed at $93.52, up 1.65%, outperforming the S&P 500's decline. The company holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) with projected Q3 2026 EPS of $0.87 (+6.1% YoY) and revenue of $12.93 billion (+4.15% YoY). However, the stock trades at a premium with a Forward P/E of 27.92 versus the industry average of 18.46, and a PEG ratio of 3.58 compared to the industry average of 1.61.

KO.title: OAAA Announces Winners of the 84th Annual OBIE Awards
KO.summary: The OAAA announced the 84th Annual OBIE Awards winners, recognizing excellence in out-of-home advertising. Paramount was inducted into the 2026 OBIE Hall of Fame for its creative excellence and commitment to OOH advertising. Random House Publishing Group and Known won the Platinum OBIE Award for 'Steph Curry Shoots the Moon,' while other major brands including Netflix, OpenAI, United Airlines, and Coca-Cola received recognition across various categories.

KO.title: How Is Coca-Cola Using Local Execution to Fuel Global Growth?
KO.summary: Coca-Cola delivered 5% unit case volume growth and 6% organic revenue growth in Q2'26 by implementing localized strategies tailored to regional preferences. The company's FIFA World Cup campaign across 180+ markets contributed to 5% Coca-Cola and 8% Powerade volume growth. Competitors PepsiCo and Monster Beverage are similarly adopting market-specific strategies. KO shares have rallied 34.5% in the past year but trade at a premium valuation of 26.46X forward P/E versus the industry average of 19.66X.

JBHT.title: J.B. Hunt Q3 Earnings Beat on Intermodal Growth and Strong Pricing
JBHT.summary: J.B. Hunt Transport Services reported Q3 2026 earnings of $1.82 per share, up 3.4% year-over-year, with revenues surging 20.4% to $3.68 billion. The Intermodal segment showed strong 20% revenue growth, while the brokerage business returned to profitability. However, operating margins contracted to 6.7% from 7.9% due to elevated driver costs, fuel expenses, and insurance claims. The company faces headwinds from cost pressures despite solid pricing improvements.

JBHT.title: JB Hunt (JBHT) Reports Q3 Earnings: What Key Metrics Have to Say
JBHT.summary: JB Hunt reported Q3 2026 revenue of $3.68 billion, up 20.4% year-over-year and beating consensus estimates by 3.15%. EPS came in at $1.82, slightly exceeding expectations. However, the stock has underperformed the broader market, declining 1.9% over the past month, and carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating.

JBHT.title: JB Hunt (JBHT) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
JBHT.summary: JB Hunt reported Q3 2026 earnings of $1.82 per share, slightly beating consensus estimates of $1.81, with revenues of $3.68 billion exceeding expectations by 3.15%. However, the company received a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating due to unfavorable estimate revision trends. The Transportation-Truck industry ranks in the bottom 35% of sectors, which could negatively impact the stock's near-term performance despite the company's year-to-date outperformance of 19.5% versus the S&P 500's 12.8%.

RUBI.title: Rubico Announces $8.5 Million Registered Direct Offering of Senior Convertible Notes and Warrants
RUBI.summary: Rubico Inc. (RUBI), a global shipping and vessel ownership company, announced a securities purchase agreement to issue $9.4M in senior convertible notes with a 10% original issue discount and warrants to purchase common shares. The company expects to receive $8.5M in gross proceeds at the first closing on October 19, 2026, with a potential second tranche of $5.5M. The notes bear 8-10% interest and mature in 12 months with optional extension to 18 months.

USB.summary: Regions Financial (RF) reported Q3 2026 adjusted earnings of 73 cents per share, beating the 67-cent estimate. LLY.title: Obesity Clinical Trial and Competitive Landscape Surges as 200+ Companies Advance Next-Generation Therapies | DelveInsight
LLY.summary: Over 200 companies are advancing next-generation obesity therapies, with more than 30 drugs in late-stage development and 180+ in mid and early stages. Key players include Eli Lilly, Novo Nordisk, Viking Therapeutics, and Roche, developing innovative mechanisms like dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists and triple hormone receptor agonists. LLY.title: Viking Therapeutics Starts Phase III Development of Obesity Pill
LLY.summary: Viking Therapeutics announced the initiation of the SUNRISE phase III program to evaluate its oral VK2735 formulation for obesity treatment. Despite positive developments, VKTX stock declined 4.4% on the announcement day and is down 27.6% year-to-date.

LLY.title: Can Nektar's Pipeline Progress Create Long-Term Value Amid Rivalry?

The company plans Phase III studies for alopecia areata in early 2027 and expects Type I diabetes data in 2027. Rezpeg, a self-administered injection that activates regulatory T-cells, faces competition from established players like Sanofi/Regeneron's Dupixent. DUOL.title: DUOL Class Action Reminder - Robbins LLP Reminds Investors of the Lead Plaintiff Deadline in the Duolingo, Inc. Securities Fraud Class Action Lawsuit

DUOL.title: Duolingo Shareholder Alert: ClaimsFiler Reminds Investors With Losses In Excess Of $100,000 Of Lead Plaintiff Deadline In Class Action Lawsuit Against Duolingo, Inc. - DUOL

APP.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges AppLovin Corporation Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
APP.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against AppLovin Corporation alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims that AppLovin made false and misleading statements regarding its generative AI video creative feature, overstating AI model improvements and the benefits of its 'virtuous cycle' value proposition. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased AppLovin securities between February 12, 2026 and August 5, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 16, 2026.

APP.title: APP Investors Have Opportunity to Lead AppLovin Corporation Securities Fraud Lawsuit with SBS Law
APP.summary: Schall, Brown & Schwartz LLP announced a class action lawsuit against AppLovin Corporation for securities violations. The lawsuit alleges the company made false and misleading statements about its generative AI video tool, overstated AI model improvements, and exaggerated benefits of its 'virtuous cycle' AI system. The class period spans February 12, 2026 to August 5, 2026, with a deadline of November 16, 2026 for investors to participate.

APP.title: ROSEN, A LONGSTANDING FIRM, Encourages AppLovin Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – APP
APP.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed securities class action lawsuits against AppLovin Corporation, Lincoln Educational Services Corporation, and Beta Bionics, Inc. The AppLovin lawsuit alleges the company made false statements regarding AI video creative features and overstated the benefits of its AI models. Investors who purchased securities during specified class periods are encouraged to seek counsel before upcoming lead plaintiff deadlines.

RXST.title: K2 Vision Has Been Recognized as the Highest-Volume Light Adjustable Lens practice in the world
RXST.summary: K2 Vision, a Pacific Northwest and Arizona-based vision correction practice, has completed 5,000 Light Adjustable Lens (LAL) procedures and been recognized by RxSight as the world's highest-volume LAL practice. The LAL is the first lens implant that can be adjusted after placement through noninvasive light treatments, allowing for customized vision correction based on patient needs.

PZZA.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Papa John's International, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
PZZA.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Papa John's International, Inc. (NASDAQ: PZZA) alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims that company executives made materially false and misleading statements regarding the company's transformation efforts, market share losses, and competitive position during the period from August 7, 2025 to August 5, 2026. Investors who purchased Papa John's securities during this period are encouraged to join the lawsuit, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 2, 2026.

IRD.title: Opus Genetics Announces FDA Approval of Phentolamine Ophthalmic Solution 0.75% for the Treatment of Presbyopia
IRD.summary: Opus Genetics announced FDA approval of phentolamine ophthalmic solution 0.75% (RYZUMVI®) for treating presbyopia in adults, expanding its previous indication for pharmacologically-induced mydriasis. The approval was supported by positive Phase 3 VEGA-2 and VEGA-3 trial results and will trigger a milestone payment from commercial partner Viatris Inc. Presbyopia affects approximately 90% of U.S. adults over 45, and the drug offers a non-invasive treatment option.

RHHBY.title: Roche Gets FDA Approval for Enspryng in Thyroid Eye Disease
RHHBY.summary: Roche announced FDA approval of Enspryng (satralizumab) for thyroid eye disease (TED), marking the drug's second approved indication. The approval was based on phase III SatraGO-2 study data showing significant improvements in eye bulging and double vision symptoms. Enspryng is also under priority FDA review for MOGAD treatment, with a decision expected January 10, 2027.

RHHBY.title: FDA approves Roche’s Enspryng, a first-in-class IL-6R inhibitor, as the first and only at-home subcutaneous treatment option for thyroid eye disease (TED)
RHHBY.summary: The FDA has approved Roche's Enspryng (satralizumab) as the first at-home subcutaneous treatment for thyroid eye disease (TED). The approval was based on Phase III SatraGO-1 and -2 studies, with SatraGO-2 demonstrating significant reductions in eye bulging (proptosis) and improvements in double vision (diplopia). Enspryng is an IL-6R inhibitor using novel recycling antibody technology and represents the second indication for the drug, following its 2020 approval for neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD).

RHHBY.title: Obesity Clinical Trial and Competitive Landscape Surges as 200+ Companies Advance Next-Generation Therapies | DelveInsight
RHHBY.summary: Over 200 companies are advancing next-generation obesity therapies, with more than 30 drugs in late-stage development and 180+ in mid and early stages. Key players include Eli Lilly, Novo Nordisk, Viking Therapeutics, and Roche, developing innovative mechanisms like dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists and triple hormone receptor agonists. Recent approvals include Novo Nordisk's oral Wegovy formulation and Eli Lilly's orforglipron, while multiple Phase III trials show promising weight loss results.

RHHBY.title: Saudi Arabia Non-Invasive Prenatal Testing Market 2026-2034: Executive Report | NGS Adoption and Healthcare Investment Drive 13.35% CAGR Toward US$162.16 Million
RHHBY.summary: Saudi Arabia's Non-Invasive Prenatal Testing (NIPT) market is projected to grow from US$52.50 million in 2025 to US$162.16 million by 2034, driven by a 13.35% CAGR. Growth is fueled by advances in next-generation sequencing, rising maternal age, increased healthcare investment, and expanding genetic testing capacity. Key players include Eurofins Scientific, Roche, Invitae, Illumina, Natera, Centogene, and Qiagen, with Riyadh and Jeddah leading regional adoption.

OPK.title: BD's Revello Stent Shows Strong AGILITY Trial Results for PAD Patients
OPK.summary: Becton, Dickinson and Company (BD) announced positive nine-month results from the AGILITY trial for its Revello Vascular Covered Stent in treating iliac artery disease. REGN.title: Libtayo® (cemiplimab) Recommended for EU Approval by the CHMP for Updated Dosing Regimen Across All Approved Cancer Types
